1: # Storyweave
2: 
3: A browser-based studio for writing branching interactive stories and exporting them as a single, dependency-free HTML file.
4: 
5: There is no build step, server, package manager, or external library. Open `index.html` in a modern browser and start writing.
6: 
7: ## Quick start
8: 
9: 1. Open `index.html` (double-click it, or serve the folder from any static file server).
10: 2. The sample story, *The Lantern at Low Tide*, loads the first time.
11: 3. Edit a scene, add choices or a direct link, then press **Playtest**.
12: 4. Use **Export → Playable HTML** to download a self-contained story you can open or share anywhere.
13: 
14: Press **New** to start from a blank one-act project. New and Import both replace the project in the editor, so export a JSON backup first if you want to keep the current story.
15: 
16: ## The editor
17: 
18: - **Story map** — the story is organized as **Acts → Chapters → Scenes**. Scenes are the playable units that hold text, choices, links, conditions, effects, and endings.
19:   - Use `+` beside an act to add a chapter, and `+` beside a chapter to add a scene. The `+` in the **Scenes** header adds a new act.
20:   - Act and chapter titles are editable inline in the story map. Use the arrow buttons to reorder acts, chapters, or the current scene, and `×` to delete one.
21:   - Deleting an act removes its chapters and scenes. Deleting a chapter removes its scenes. Choices and direct links that pointed to removed scenes are cleared, and an opening scene is chosen automatically if needed. A story keeps at least one act, each act keeps at least one chapter, and each chapter keeps at least one scene.
22: - **Scenes** — select a scene row to edit it. The editor header shows its act, chapter, and position. Use the header arrows to reorder it within its chapter.
23: - **Story begins at** — chooses the scene the reader sees first.
24: - **Write / Preview** — Write shows the markup source; Preview renders the scene using its initial variable values and current theme.
25: - **Flow** — each scene has one of three endings:
26:   - **Choices** — readers pick from one or more labeled choices.
27:   - **Direct link** — a single “continue” button leads to another scene.
28:   - **Ending** — the story stops here.
29: - **Categories** — the right-hand panel organizes story state into as many categories as you need. Add, rename, reorder, or delete them with the buttons in each category header.
30:   - **Stat sheet** categories show every variable and its current value. Variables can be a **number**, **text**, or **true / false** value.
31:   - **Inventory** categories show only variables whose count is above zero, with a `×` count.
32:   - Use categories for stats, inventory, field notes, clues, relationships, or anything else the reader should see.
33: - **Stat screen title** — names the in-story state panel. Call it *Story state*, *Stat sheet*, *Field notes*, *Inventory*, or anything else. The title is part of the project and is saved with it, but the exported story has no editor for changing it.
34: - **Cover & ending** — edit the cover subtitle, ending title, ending message, and ending button label. These appear in playtest and in exported stories, and line breaks are preserved. Leave the subtitle or message blank to hide it.
35: - **Theme & images** — choose a body font, heading font, accent color, background, text color, scene title color, and choice text color. Scene title and choice text start out matching the text color; change their swatches to give them a different color. All fonts are self-contained system stacks, so exported stories never load a web font. Uploaded images are compressed when needed and stored inside the project as data URLs.
36: - **Playtest** — runs the story from the beginning with live categories, restart, and an optional **Show locked choices** view. The state panel never shows a path or history.
37: 
38: Everything is saved automatically to this browser's `localStorage` under `storyweave.project.v1`. The save indicator in the header confirms it. Clearing browser site data removes the autosave, so use **Export → Project JSON** for backups.
39: 
40: Projects saved before the Act → Chapter → Scene update are migrated automatically when loaded. Their old chapters become scenes under **Act I / Chapter 1**, keeping their IDs, links, and opening scene.
41: 
42: ## IDs, display names, and categories
43: 
44: Every variable has two names:
45: 
46: - **ID** — the bare identifier used inside commands, such as `courage` or `lantern`.
47: - **Display name** — the reader-facing label shown on the stat screen, such as *Courage* or *Brass Lantern*.
48: 
49: Variables live in categories, and each category chooses how it is displayed:
50: 
51: - **Stat sheet** — every variable in the category is listed with its value.
52: - **Inventory** — variables are treated as counted items. Items at zero are hidden, and the rest show as `×count`.
53: 
54: Commands still use two namespaces:
55: 
56: - `var:` for variables in stat-sheet categories
57: - `item:` for variables in inventory categories
58: 
59: For example, the sample project uses the stat ID `courage` and the item ID `lantern`:
60: 
61: ```text
62: [var:courage]            shows the stat value in text
63: [item:lantern]           shows the item count in text
64: [if item:lantern]...[/if]   true while the reader carries at least one
65: item:lantern += 1        add one lantern to the inventory
66: item:lantern -= 1        remove one
67: ```
68: 
69: Bare IDs such as `courage` and `lantern` also work in older projects and commands, but the `var:` and `item:` prefixes make the intended collection clear.
70: 
71: Stat-sheet variables support:
72: 
73: - **Number** — a value such as courage, gold, or score.
74: - **Text** — a name, title, or other string.
75: - **True / false** — a single flag.
76: 
77: Inventory variables are always counted. Categories are shown in the order you arrange them, and the playtest and exported player both use the project's stat screen title. The state panel shows current categories and values only; it does not show a path or history. Projects saved with the older fixed **Stats** and **Inventory** sections are migrated into equivalent categories automatically.
78: 
79: ## Special text markup
80: 
81: Formatting tags can be nested.
82: 
83: | Markup | Result |
84: | --- | --- |
85: | `[b]bold[/b]` | **bold** |
86: | `[i]italic[/i]` | *italic* |
87: | `[u]underline[/u]` | underline |
88: | `[s]struck[/s]` | strikethrough |
89: | `[big]larger[/big]` | larger text |
90: | `[small]smaller[/small]` | smaller text |
91: | `[color=#b75435]warm[/color]` | colored text (hex, named color, `rgb()`, or `hsl()`) |
92: | `[mark]highlighted[/mark]` | highlighted text |
93: | `[center]centered[/center]` | centered block |
94: | `[heading]Heading[/heading]` | section heading |
95: | `[quote]Quoted line[/quote]` | indented quotation |
96: | `[code]literal[/code]` | inline code |
97: | `[accent]accent[/accent]` | accent-colored text |
98: | `[muted]muted[/muted]` | muted text |
99: | `[hr]` | horizontal divider |
100: | `[br]` | line break |
101: | `[img:image_id]` | an embedded image from **Theme & images** |
102: | `\[` | a literal `[` |
103: 
104: Aliases: `[strong]`, `[em]`, `[strike]`, `[del]`, and `[highlight]`.
105: 
106: ### Variables, images, and conditions inside text
107: 
108: ```text
109: [var:courage]                         Show a stat's current value.
110: [item:lantern]                        Show an item's current count.
111: [img:image_id]                        Show an embedded image.
112: [set var:gold = 2]                    Set a stat while the text renders.
113: [set item:lantern += 1]               Also supports -=, *=, /=, ++, and --.
114: 
115: [if var:courage >= 2]The door opens.[/if]
116: 
117: [if item:lantern]You carry a light.[else]It is dark.[/if]
118: ```
119: 
120: Conditions support:
121: 
122: - Comparisons: `=`, `==`, `!=`, `>`, `>=`, `<`, `<=`, `is`, `is not`
123: - Text: `contains`
124: - Boolean logic: `and`, `or`, `not`, with parentheses
125: - Arithmetic inside expressions: `+`, `-`, `*`, `/`, `%`
126: - Values: numbers, `true`, `false`, `null`, quoted strings, and variable names
127: 
128: Examples:
129: 
130: ```text
131: var:courage >= 2 and item:lantern
132: var:name is "Mira"
133: var:gold >= 1
134: not (var:courage < 1)
135: ```
136: 
137: ### Conditional choices and effects
138: 
139: Each choice has optional **Condition** and **Effects** fields under *Condition & effects*.
140: 
141: - **Show only if** hides the choice when the condition is false. Blank means always visible.
142: - **Set stats & items** runs when the choice is selected. Separate multiple effects with a new line or `;`.
143: 
144: ```text
145: var:courage += 1
146: item:lantern += 1
147: item:oil -= 1
148: var:name = "Mira"
149: ```
150: 
151: Direct links can also run effects when the reader continues. A scene's **On enter** effects run before its text every time it opens.
152: 
153: ## Exports
154: 
155: ### Playable HTML
156: 
157: Downloads one `.html` file containing the story, engine, styles, player, cover and ending text, theme, and any embedded images. It has no external dependencies and works offline. Readers open the state panel with the button in the top bar; its title, categories, and contents are fixed by the exported project.
158: 
159: ### Saving progress in an exported story
160: 
161: Exported stories include manual save and load controls. They do not write saves to the browser, so a reader can keep progress without leaving anything behind on a shared device.
162: 
163: - **Save** in the top bar opens a save key. Copy the key as text or download it as a small `.txt` file. The key contains the current scene, variables, inventory, and ending state. It also keeps a small internal path record for compatibility, but the player never displays a path or history.
164: - **Load** in the top bar — or **Load a saved game** on the cover — accepts a pasted key or an uploaded save file.
165: - Save keys look like `SW-THE-LANTERN-AT-LOW-TIDE-A2-C1-<base62 payload>`. The title and act/chapter labels are readable; the payload is a compact, case-sensitive Base62 encoding. Treat the whole key as one value and do not edit it.
166: - Keys are tied to the story and its version. If the story has changed since the save was made, the player shows **Version mismatch, accuracy not guaranteed!** and offers a best-effort load. When the version matches, the saved scene and state are restored. After a mismatch, the player resumes at the saved scene with a best-effort state. Missing scenes fall back to the story's beginning, and variables that no longer exist are skipped.
167: - A save file is plain text containing the same key. It can be renamed, copied, or stored anywhere.
168: 
169: Playtest uses the editor's live preview and does not create save keys. Export **Playable HTML** to test saving and loading exactly as a reader will use it.
170: 
171: ### Project JSON
172: 
173: Downloads an editable backup. Use **Import** to restore it later.
174: 
175: ## Files
176: 
177: - `index.html` — editor shell
178: - `styles.css` — editor and playtest styling
179: - `engine.js` — markup, conditions, effects, and variable engine
180: - `app.js` — editor state, sample story, playtest, import/export, and the standalone player template
181: 
182: `engine.js` is also embedded verbatim into exported stories, so the editor and exported player evaluate text and conditions the same way.

"""SQLite persistence for voices, reference clips, training jobs and generations."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import shutil
import sqlite3
import threading
import time
import uuid
from contextlib import contextmanager
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Iterable

EMOTIONS = [
    "neutral",
    "happy",
    "sad",
    "angry",
    "excited",
    "calm",
    "fearful",
    "whisper",
]

SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS voices (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    language TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'en',
    consent INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
    engine TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    model_meta TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    created_at REAL NOT NULL,
    updated_at REAL NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS clips (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    voice_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES voices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    emotion TEXT NOT NULL,
    path TEXT NOT NULL,
    duration REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    transcript TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    metrics TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    created_at REAL NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS clips_voice ON clips(voice_id, emotion);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS generations (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    voice_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    text TEXT NOT NULL,
    emotion TEXT NOT NULL,
    intensity REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    speed REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    language TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'en',
    engine TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    path TEXT NOT NULL,
    duration REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at REAL NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS generations_created ON generations(created_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jobs (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    voice_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued',
    progress REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    message TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    log TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at REAL NOT NULL,
    finished_at REAL
);
"""


def _now() -> float:
    return time.time()


def new_id(prefix: str) -> str:
    return f"{prefix}_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"


class Store:
    def __init__(self, root: Path):
        self.root = Path(root)
        self.voices_root = self.root / "voices"
        self.outputs_root = self.root / "outputs"
        self.voices_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.outputs_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.db_path = self.root / "timbre.db"
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        with self._db() as db:
            db.executescript(SCHEMA)
        self._recover_interrupted()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ infra

    def _conn(self) -> sqlite3.Connection:
        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_path, timeout=30)
        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
        conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
        return conn

    @contextmanager
    def _db(self):
        with self._lock:
            conn = self._conn()
            try:
                yield conn
                conn.commit()
            finally:
                conn.close()

    def _recover_interrupted(self) -> None:
        """Jobs cannot survive a restart; mark them failed instead of spinning forever."""
        with self._db() as db:
            db.execute(
                "UPDATE jobs SET status='error', error=?, message=?, finished_at=? "
                "WHERE status IN ('queued','running')",
                ("Server restarted while this job was running.", "Interrupted", _now()),
            )
            db.execute(
                "UPDATE voices SET status='draft', error=? WHERE status='training'",
                ("Training was interrupted. Run it again.",),
            )

    def voice_dir(self, voice_id: str) -> Path:
        return self.voices_root / voice_id

    def clips_dir(self, voice_id: str) -> Path:
        return self.voice_dir(voice_id) / "clips"

    def model_dir(self, voice_id: str) -> Path:
        return self.voice_dir(voice_id) / "model"

    def output_path(self, generation_id: str) -> Path:
        return self.outputs_root / f"{generation_id}.wav"

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------- voices

    def create_voice(
        self, name: str, description: str, language: str, consent: bool
    ) -> dict:
        voice_id = new_id("v")
        now = _now()
        with self._db() as db:
            db.execute(
                "INSERT INTO voices (id, name, description, language, consent, status, "
                "created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'draft', ?, ?)",
                (voice_id, name, description, language, 1 if consent else 0, now, now),
            )
        self.clips_dir(voice_id).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.model_dir(voice_id).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        return self.get_voice(voice_id)

    def list_voices(self) -> list[dict]:
        with self._db() as db:
            rows = db.execute("SELECT * FROM voices ORDER BY created_at DESC").fetchall()
            return [self._voice_row(db, row) for row in rows]

    def get_voice(self, voice_id: str) -> dict | None:
        with self._db() as db:
            row = db.execute("SELECT * FROM voices WHERE id=?", (voice_id,)).fetchone()
            return self._voice_row(db, row) if row else None

    def update_voice(self, voice_id: str, **fields: Any) -> dict | None:
        allowed = {"name", "description", "language", "status", "engine", "error"}
        patch = {k: v for k, v in fields.items() if k in allowed}
        if patch:
            patch["updated_at"] = _now()
            sets = ", ".join(f"{k}=?" for k in patch)
            with self._db() as db:
                db.execute(
                    f"UPDATE voices SET {sets} WHERE id=?",
                    (*patch.values(), voice_id),
                )
        return self.get_voice(voice_id)

    def set_model_meta(self, voice_id: str, meta: dict, *, status: str, engine: str = "") -> None:
        with self._db() as db:
            db.execute(
                "UPDATE voices SET model_meta=?, status=?, engine=?, error='', updated_at=? "
                "WHERE id=?",
                (json.dumps(meta), status, engine, _now(), voice_id),
            )

    def mark_stale(self, voice_id: str) -> None:
        """Samples changed after training — keep the model usable but flag it."""
        with self._db() as db:
            row = db.execute("SELECT model_meta, status FROM voices WHERE id=?", (voice_id,)).fetchone()
            if not row:
                return
            meta = json.loads(row["model_meta"] or "{}")
            if row["status"] == "ready" and meta.get("emotions"):
                meta["stale"] = True
                db.execute(
                    "UPDATE voices SET model_meta=?, updated_at=? WHERE id=?",
                    (json.dumps(meta), _now(), voice_id),
                )

    def delete_voice(self, voice_id: str) -> None:
        with self._db() as db:
            db.execute("DELETE FROM clips WHERE voice_id=?", (voice_id,))
            db.execute("DELETE FROM jobs WHERE voice_id=?", (voice_id,))
            db.execute("DELETE FROM voices WHERE id=?", (voice_id,))
            generation_paths = [
                row["path"]
                for row in db.execute(
                    "SELECT path FROM generations WHERE voice_id=?", (voice_id,)
                ).fetchall()
            ]
            db.execute("DELETE FROM generations WHERE voice_id=?", (voice_id,))
        for rel in generation_paths:
            (self.root / rel).unlink(missing_ok=True)
        shutil.rmtree(self.voice_dir(voice_id), ignore_errors=True)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ clips

    def add_clip(
        self,
        voice_id: str,
        emotion: str,
        path: Path,
        duration: float,
        transcript: str,
        metrics: dict,
    ) -> dict:
        clip_id = new_id("c")
        with self._db() as db:
            db.execute(
                "INSERT INTO clips (id, voice_id, emotion, path, duration, transcript, "
                "metrics, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (
                    clip_id,
                    voice_id,
                    emotion,
                    str(path.relative_to(self.root)).replace("\\", "/"),
                    round(float(duration), 3),
                    transcript,
                    json.dumps(metrics),
                    _now(),
                ),
            )
            db.execute("UPDATE voices SET updated_at=? WHERE id=?", (_now(), voice_id))
        self.mark_stale(voice_id)
        return self.get_clip(clip_id)

    def list_clips(self, voice_id: str) -> list[dict]:
        with self._db() as db:
            rows = db.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM clips WHERE voice_id=? ORDER BY created_at ASC", (voice_id,)
            ).fetchall()
            return [self._clip_row(row) for row in rows]

    def get_clip(self, clip_id: str) -> dict | None:
        with self._db() as db:
            row = db.execute("SELECT * FROM clips WHERE id=?", (clip_id,)).fetchone()
            return self._clip_row(row) if row else None

    def delete_clip(self, clip_id: str) -> dict | None:
        with self._db() as db:
            row = db.execute("SELECT * FROM clips WHERE id=?", (clip_id,)).fetchone()
            if not row:
                return None
            db.execute("DELETE FROM clips WHERE id=?", (clip_id,))
            db.execute(
                "UPDATE voices SET updated_at=? WHERE id=?", (_now(), row["voice_id"])
            )
        (self.root / row["path"]).unlink(missing_ok=True)
        self.mark_stale(row["voice_id"])
        return self._clip_row(row)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------- jobs

    def create_job(self, voice_id: str, kind: str) -> dict:
        job_id = new_id("j")
        with self._db() as db:
            db.execute(
                "INSERT INTO jobs (id, voice_id, kind, status, progress, message, log, created_at) "
                "VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'queued', 0, 'Queued', '', ?)",
                (job_id, voice_id, kind, _now()),
            )
        return self.get_job(job_id)

    def get_job(self, job_id: str) -> dict | None:
        with self._db() as db:
            row = db.execute("SELECT * FROM jobs WHERE id=?", (job_id,)).fetchone()
            return dict(row) if row else None

    def latest_job(self, voice_id: str, kind: str | None = None) -> dict | None:
        query = "SELECT * FROM jobs WHERE voice_id=?"
        args: list[Any] = [voice_id]
        if kind:
            query += " AND kind=?"
            args.append(kind)
        query += " ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1"
        with self._db() as db:
            row = db.execute(query, args).fetchone()
            return dict(row) if row else None

    def update_job(
        self,
        job_id: str,
        *,
        status: str | None = None,
        progress: float | None = None,
        message: str | None = None,
        log_line: str | None = None,
        error: str | None = None,
        finished: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        fields: dict[str, Any] = {}
        if status is not None:
            fields["status"] = status
        if progress is not None:
            fields["progress"] = max(0.0, min(100.0, float(progress)))
        if message is not None:
            fields["message"] = message
        if error is not None:
            fields["error"] = error
        if finished:
            fields["finished_at"] = _now()
        if log_line:
            with self._db() as db:
                row = db.execute("SELECT log FROM jobs WHERE id=?", (job_id,)).fetchone()
                previous = (row["log"] if row else "") or ""
                fields["log"] = (previous + log_line.rstrip() + "\n")[-20000:]
        if not fields:
            return
        sets = ", ".join(f"{k}=?" for k in fields)
        with self._db() as db:
            db.execute(f"UPDATE jobs SET {sets} WHERE id=?", (*fields.values(), job_id))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ generations

    def add_generation(
        self,
        *,
        generation_id: str,
        voice_id: str,
        text: str,
        emotion: str,
        intensity: float,
        speed: float,
        language: str,
        engine: str,
        path: Path,
        duration: float,
    ) -> dict:
        with self._db() as db:
            db.execute(
                "INSERT INTO generations (id, voice_id, text, emotion, intensity, speed, "
                "language, engine, path, duration, created_at) "
                "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (
                    generation_id,
                    voice_id,
                    text,
                    emotion,
                    intensity,
                    speed,
                    language,
                    engine,
                    str(path.relative_to(self.root)).replace("\\", "/"),
                    duration,
                    _now(),
                ),
            )
        return self.get_generation(generation_id)

    def get_generation(self, generation_id: str) -> dict | None:
        with self._db() as db:
            row = db.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM generations WHERE id=?", (generation_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            return self._generation_row(row) if row else None

    def list_generations(self, limit: int = 100) -> list[dict]:
        with self._db() as db:
            rows = db.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM generations ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT ?", (limit,)
            ).fetchall()
            return [self._generation_row(row) for row in rows]

    def delete_generation(self, generation_id: str) -> dict | None:
        generation = self.get_generation(generation_id)
        if not generation:
            return None
        with self._db() as db:
            db.execute("DELETE FROM generations WHERE id=?", (generation_id,))
        (self.root / generation["path"]).unlink(missing_ok=True)
        return generation

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ mappers

    def _voice_row(self, db: sqlite3.Connection, row: sqlite3.Row) -> dict:
        voice = dict(row)
        voice["consent"] = bool(voice["consent"])
        voice["model"] = json.loads(voice.pop("model_meta") or "{}")
        clips = db.execute(
            "SELECT emotion, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(duration), 0) AS seconds "
            "FROM clips WHERE voice_id=? GROUP BY emotion",
            (voice["id"],),
        ).fetchall()
        samples = {
            c["emotion"]: {
                "count": c["count"],
                "seconds": round(c["seconds"], 2),
            }
            for c in clips
        }
        voice["samples"] = samples
        voice["clip_count"] = sum(s["count"] for s in samples.values())
        voice["total_seconds"] = round(sum(s["seconds"] for s in samples.values()), 2)
        voice["emotions_ready"] = sorted(
            voice["model"].get("emotions", {}).keys(),
            key=lambda e: EMOTIONS.index(e) if e in EMOTIONS else 99,
        )
        return voice

    def _clip_row(self, row: sqlite3.Row) -> dict:
        clip = dict(row)
        clip["metrics"] = json.loads(clip["metrics"] or "{}")
        clip["url"] = f"/api/clips/{clip['id']}/audio"
        return clip

    def _generation_row(self, row: sqlite3.Row) -> dict:
        generation = dict(row)
        generation["url"] = f"/api/generations/{generation['id']}/audio"
        return generation

"""Synthesis engines.

`XttsEngine` is the real voice-cloning path: it uses Coqui XTTS v2 in zero-shot
mode, but caches one conditioning latent per emotion so each take can be
re-synthesised with a different emotional reference in a fraction of a second.

`MockEngine` writes placeholder tones. It exists so the whole app (upload →
train → synthesise → history) can be exercised without torch or a GPU:

    $env:TIMBRE_ENGINE = "mock"
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.util
import json
import math
import os
import re
import threading
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import soundfile as sf

XTTS_MODEL = os.environ.get("TIMBRE_XTTS_MODEL", "tts_models/multilingual/multi-dataset/xtts_v2")
OUTPUT_SR = 24000


class EngineError(RuntimeError):
    pass


class EngineUnavailable(EngineError):
    pass


def _read_latent(path: Path):
    import torch

    payload = torch.load(str(path), map_location="cpu")
    return payload["gpt_cond_latent"], payload["speaker_embedding"]


def _as_float_array(value) -> np.ndarray:
    if hasattr(value, "detach"):
        value = value.detach().cpu().float().numpy()
    return np.asarray(value, dtype=np.float32).reshape(-1)


class BaseEngine:
    key = "base"
    label = "Base"
    output_sr = OUTPUT_SR

    def status(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "key": self.key,
            "label": self.label,
            "installed": True,
            "state": "ready",
            "device": "cpu",
            "error": "",
        }

    def load(self):
        return self

    def train_emotion(self, wav_paths: list[Path], out_path: Path) -> dict:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def synthesize(
        self,
        *,
        text: str,
        language: str,
        speed: float,
        out_path: Path,
        emotion: str,
        intensity: float,
        latents: dict[str, Path],
        ref_paths: list[Path],
    ) -> dict:
        raise NotImplementedError


class XttsEngine(BaseEngine):
    key = "xtts"
    label = "XTTS v2"

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._tts = None
        self._device = "cpu"
        self._state = "idle"
        self._error = ""
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        self._installed = importlib.util.find_spec("TTS") is not None

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ status

    def status(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "key": self.key,
            "label": self.label,
            "installed": self._installed,
            "state": "error" if self._error and self._state != "loading" else self._state,
            "device": self._device,
            "error": self._error,
            "model": XTTS_MODEL,
        }

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------- load

    def load(self):
        if self._tts is not None:
            return self._tts
        with self._lock:
            if self._tts is not None:
                return self._tts
            if not self._installed:
                raise EngineUnavailable(
                    "The XTTS engine is not installed. Run `run.ps1` (or "
                    "`pip install -r requirements-engine.txt`) to install torch and "
                    "coqui-tts. Set TIMBRE_ENGINE=mock to test the app without them."
                )
            self._state = "loading"
            try:
                import torch
                from TTS.api import TTS

                requested = os.environ.get("TIMBRE_DEVICE", "auto").strip().lower()
                if requested in {"cpu", "cuda"}:
                    device = requested
                else:
                    device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"

                tts = TTS(XTTS_MODEL).to(device)
                self._tts = tts
                self._device = device
                self._state = "ready"
                self._error = ""
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                self._state = "error"
                self._error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
                raise EngineError(
                    "Could not load XTTS. The first run downloads ~1.8 GB. "
                    f"Underlying error: {self._error}"
                ) from exc
        return self._tts

    @property
    def sample_rate(self) -> int:
        if self._tts is not None:
            try:
                return int(self._tts.synthesizer.output_sample_rate)
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                pass
        return OUTPUT_SR

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- training

    def train_emotion(self, wav_paths: list[Path], out_path: Path) -> dict:
        import torch

        tts = self.load()
        model = tts.synthesizer.tts_model
        paths = [str(p) for p in wav_paths]

        try:
            gpt_cond, speaker = model.get_conditioning_latents(audio_path=paths)
        except TypeError:
            # Older/newer builds expose slightly different signatures.
            gpt_cond, speaker = model.get_conditioning_latents(
                audio_path=paths,
                gpt_cond_len=30,
                gpt_cond_chunk_len=6,
                max_ref_len=30,
                sound_norm_refs=False,
            )

        out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        torch.save(
            {
                "gpt_cond_latent": gpt_cond.detach().cpu(),
                "speaker_embedding": speaker.detach().cpu(),
            },
            str(out_path),
        )
        return {
            "latent": os.path.relpath(out_path, out_path.parent.parent),
            "tensor_shape": list(gpt_cond.shape),
        }

    # --------------------------------------------------------------- synthesis

    def _blend(self, emotion: str, intensity: float, latents: dict[str, Path]):
        emotion_path = latents.get(emotion) or latents.get("neutral")
        if emotion_path is None:
            return None
        gpt_e, spk_e = _read_latent(emotion_path)
        neutral_path = latents.get("neutral")
        if (
            emotion != "neutral"
            and neutral_path is not None
            and 0.0 <= intensity < 0.999
        ):
            gpt_n, spk_n = _read_latent(neutral_path)
            if tuple(gpt_n.shape) == tuple(gpt_e.shape):
                gpt_e = gpt_n + (gpt_e - gpt_n) * float(intensity)
            if tuple(spk_n.shape) == tuple(spk_e.shape):
                spk_e = spk_n + (spk_e - spk_n) * float(intensity)
        return gpt_e, spk_e

    def synthesize(
        self,
        *,
        text: str,
        language: str,
        speed: float,
        out_path: Path,
        emotion: str,
        intensity: float,
        latents: dict[str, Path],
        ref_paths: list[Path],
    ) -> dict:
        tts = self.load()
        model = tts.synthesizer.tts_model
        sr = self.sample_rate

        wav = None
        conditioners = self._blend(emotion, intensity, latents) if latents else None
        if conditioners is None and ref_paths:
            try:
                conditioners = tuple(
                    t if hasattr(t, "cpu") else t
                    for t in model.get_conditioning_latents(
                        audio_path=[str(p) for p in ref_paths]
                    )
                )
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                conditioners = None

        if conditioners is not None:
            gpt_cond, speaker = conditioners
            try:
                gpt_cond = gpt_cond.to(self._device)
                speaker = speaker.to(self._device)
            except AttributeError:
                pass
            params = {
                "text": text,
                "language": language,
                "gpt_cond_latent": gpt_cond,
                "speaker_embedding": speaker,
                "speed": float(speed),
                "enable_text_splitting": True,
            }
            try:
                result = model.inference(**params)
            except TypeError:
                params.pop("enable_text_splitting", None)
                result = model.inference(**params)
            wav = result["wav"] if isinstance(result, dict) else result
            sr = int(result.get("sample_rate", sr)) if isinstance(result, dict) else sr

        if wav is None:
            # Last-resort path: the high-level API. Slower (recomputes the
            # conditioning every call) but very stable across TTS versions.
            if not ref_paths:
                raise EngineError("No reference audio is available for this voice.")
            result = tts.tts(
                text=text,
                speaker_wav=[str(p) for p in ref_paths],
                language=language,
                speed=float(speed),
            )
            wav = np.asarray(result, dtype=np.float32)

        samples = _as_float_array(wav)
        if samples.size == 0:
            raise EngineError("The engine returned empty audio.")
        peak = float(np.max(np.abs(samples)))
        if peak > 1.0:
            samples = samples / peak
        out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        sf.write(str(out_path), samples, sr, subtype="PCM_16")
        return {"sample_rate": sr, "duration": round(len(samples) / sr, 3)}


class MockEngine(BaseEngine):
    """Placeholder tones, shaped by emotion. Never presented as a real clone."""

    key = "mock"
    label = "Mock (placeholder)"
    output_sr = OUTPUT_SR

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._state = "ready"

    def status(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "key": self.key,
            "label": self.label,
            "installed": True,
            "state": "ready",
            "device": "cpu",
            "error": "",
            "model": "sine placeholder — set TIMBRE_ENGINE=auto for real cloning",
        }

    def train_emotion(self, wav_paths: list[Path], out_path: Path) -> dict:
        out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        payload = {
            "mock": True,
            "refs": [str(p) for p in wav_paths],
            "seconds": round(
                sum(sf.info(str(p)).frames / sf.info(str(p)).samplerate for p in wav_paths), 2
            ),
        }
        out_path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        return {"latent": out_path.name, "mock": True}

    def synthesize(
        self,
        *,
        text: str,
        language: str,
        speed: float,
        out_path: Path,
        emotion: str,
        intensity: float,
        latents: dict[str, Path],
        ref_paths: list[Path],
    ) -> dict:
        sr = OUTPUT_SR
        rate = {
            "neutral": 1.0,
            "happy": 1.22,
            "sad": 0.84,
            "angry": 1.08,
            "excited": 1.3,
            "calm": 0.9,
            "fearful": 1.14,
            "whisper": 0.96,
        }.get(emotion, 1.0)
        rate = 1.0 + (rate - 1.0) * max(0.0, min(1.0, intensity))
        rng = np.random.default_rng(abs(hash(text)) % (2**32))
        words = re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9']+", text)[:80] or ["placeholder"]
        base_f0 = 118.0 * rate
        chunks: list[np.ndarray] = []
        for word in words:
            dur = max(0.12, (0.1 + 0.055 * len(word)) / max(0.5, speed))
            n = int(dur * sr)
            if n < 32:
                continue
            t = np.arange(n) / sr
            f0 = base_f0 * (1 + 0.05 * np.sin(2 * math.pi * 2.4 * t + rng.random()))
            phase = 2 * math.pi * np.cumsum(f0) / sr
            tone = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.float32)
            for harmonic in range(1, 7):

            chunks.append(tone)
            chunks.append(np.zeros(int(0.05 * sr), dtype=np.float32))
        wav = np.concatenate(chunks) if chunks else np.zeros(sr // 2, dtype=np.float32)

        out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        sf.write(str(out_path), wav, sr, subtype="PCM_16")
        return {"sample_rate": sr, "duration": round(len(wav) / sr, 3), "mock": True}

MIN_NEUTRAL_SECONDS = 6.0
MIN_EMOTION_SECONDS = 4.0
TARGET_NEUTRAL_SECONDS = 30.0
TARGET_EMOTION_SECONDS = 15.0
MAX_REF_SECONDS = 40.0
MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES = 64 * 1024 * 1024

store = Store(DATA_DIR)
engine = build_engine()
TMP_DIR = DATA_DIR / "tmp"
TMP_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

app = FastAPI(title="Timbre", version="1.0.0")
app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=False,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------- schemas


class VoiceCreate(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)
    description: str = Field(default="", max_length=400)
    language: str = Field(default="en", max_length=12)
    consent: bool = False

    @field_validator("name")
    @classmethod
    def _clean_name(cls, value: str) -> str:
        value = " ".join(value.split())
        if not value:
            raise ValueError("Give the voice a name.")
        return value


class VoiceUpdate(BaseModel):
    name: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=80)
    description: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, max_length=400)
    language: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, max_length=12)


class SpeakIn(BaseModel):
    text: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=2000)
    emotion: str = "neutral"
    intensity: float = Field(default=1.0, ge=0.0, le=1.0)
    speed: float = Field(default=1.0, ge=0.5, le=1.5)
    language: Optional[str] = None

    @field_validator("text")
    @classmethod
    def _clean_text(cls, value: str) -> str:
        value = value.strip()
        if not value:
            raise ValueError("Enter some text to speak.")
        return value

    @field_validator("emotion")
    @classmethod
    def _known_emotion(cls, value: str) -> str:
        if value not in EMOTIONS:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown emotion '{value}'.")
        return value


# --------------------------------------------------------------------- helpers


def _voice_or_404(voice_id: str) -> dict:
    voice = store.get_voice(voice_id)
    if not voice:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Voice not found.")
    return voice


def _clip_path(clip: dict) -> Path:
    return store.root / clip["path"]


def _warnings_for(clip: dict) -> list[dict]:
    return clip_warnings(clip.get("metrics", {}), emotion=clip["emotion"])


def _pick_refs(clips: list[dict], limit: float = MAX_REF_SECONDS) -> tuple[list[dict], float]:
    """Prefer the longest takes first, but never exceed the conditioning budget."""
    ordered = sorted(clips, key=lambda c: c["duration"], reverse=True)
    picked: list[dict] = []
    seconds = 0.0
    for clip in ordered:
        if picked and seconds + clip["duration"] > limit:
            continue
        picked.append(clip)
        seconds += clip["duration"]
        if seconds >= limit:
            break
    return picked, round(seconds, 2)


def _latest_training_job(voice_id: str) -> Optional[dict]:
    return store.latest_job(voice_id, "train")


def _voice_payload(voice: dict) -> dict:
    voice = dict(voice)
    voice["targets"] = {
        "neutral": TARGET_NEUTRAL_SECONDS,
        "other": TARGET_EMOTION_SECONDS,
        "min_neutral": MIN_NEUTRAL_SECONDS,
        "min_emotion": MIN_EMOTION_SECONDS,
    }
    job = _latest_training_job(voice["id"])
    voice["job"] = job
    return voice


def _safe_detail(exc: Exception) -> str:
    message = str(exc).strip() or exc.__class__.__name__
    return message[:1200]


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------- meta


@app.get("/api/health")
async def health() -> dict:
    status = engine.status()
    model_cached = False
    if status.get("key") == "xtts":
        try:
            from TTS.utils.manage import ModelManager  # noqa: F401

            model_cached = any(
                p.exists()
                for p in [
                    Path.home() / "AppData/Local/tts",
                    Path.home() / ".local/share/tts",
                ]
            )
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            model_cached = False
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "engine": status,
        "device": status.get("device", "cpu"),
        "model_cached": model_cached,
        "emotions": EMOTIONS,
        "limits": {
            "min_neutral": MIN_NEUTRAL_SECONDS,
            "min_emotion": MIN_EMOTION_SECONDS,
            "target_neutral": TARGET_NEUTRAL_SECONDS,
            "target_emotion": TARGET_EMOTION_SECONDS,
            "max_ref": MAX_REF_SECONDS,
            "max_upload_mb": MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES // (1024 * 1024),
        },
        "data_dir": str(DATA_DIR),
        "engine_override": os.environ.get("TIMBRE_ENGINE", "auto"),
        "version": app.version,
    }


@app.post("/api/engine/load")
async def load_engine() -> dict:
    """Warm the model up (download on first use) without training a voice."""

    def warm() -> None:
        try:
            engine.load()
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            pass

    asyncio.get_running_loop().run_in_executor(None, warm)
    return {"started": True, "status": engine.status()}


# --------------------------------------------------------------------- voices


@app.get("/api/voices")
async def list_voices() -> list[dict]:
    return [_voice_payload(v) for v in store.list_voices()]


@app.post("/api/voices", status_code=201)
async def create_voice(payload: VoiceCreate) -> dict:
    if not payload.consent:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail="Confirm that you have permission to clone this voice.",
        )
    voice = store.create_voice(
        name=payload.name,
        description=payload.description.strip(),
        language=payload.language,
        consent=payload.consent,
    )
    return _voice_payload(voice)


@app.get("/api/voices/{voice_id}")
async def get_voice(voice_id: str) -> dict:
    return _voice_payload(_voice_or_404(voice_id))


@app.patch("/api/voices/{voice_id}")
async def update_voice(voice_id: str, payload: VoiceUpdate) -> dict:
    _voice_or_404(voice_id)
    fields = payload.model_dump(exclude_none=True)
    if "name" in fields:
        fields["name"] = " ".join(fields["name"].split())
        if not fields["name"]:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Name cannot be blank.")
    return _voice_payload(store.update_voice(voice_id, **fields) or {})


@app.delete("/api/voices/{voice_id}", status_code=204)
async def delete_voice(voice_id: str) -> None:
    voice = _voice_or_404(voice_id)
    if voice["status"] == "training":
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=409, detail="Wait for training to finish before deleting this voice."
        )
    store.delete_voice(voice_id)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------- clips


@app.get("/api/voices/{voice_id}/clips")
async def list_clips(voice_id: str) -> list[dict]:
    _voice_or_404(voice_id)
    clips = store.list_clips(voice_id)
    for clip in clips:
        clip["warnings"] = _warnings_for(clip)
    return clips


@app.post("/api/voices/{voice_id}/clips", status_code=201)
async def upload_clip(
    voice_id: str,
    file: Annotated[UploadFile, File()],
    emotion: Annotated[str, Form()] = "neutral",
    transcript: Annotated[str, Form()] = "",
) -> dict:
    voice = _voice_or_404(voice_id)
    if emotion not in EMOTIONS:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Unknown emotion '{emotion}'.")

    raw = await file.read()
    if not raw:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="The upload was empty.")
    if len(raw) > MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=413, detail="That file is too large (64 MB max).")

    tmp_path = TMP_DIR / f"{new_id('up')}.wav"
    tmp_path.write_bytes(raw)
    clip_id = new_id("c")
    final_path = store.clips_dir(voice_id) / f"{emotion}-{clip_id}.wav"
    try:
        metrics = prepare_wav(tmp_path, final_path)
    except AudioError as exc:
        final_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        final_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=f"Could not process that audio ({_safe_detail(exc)}).",
        ) from exc
    finally:
        tmp_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)

    clip = store.add_clip(
        voice_id=voice_id,
        emotion=emotion,
        path=final_path,
        duration=metrics["duration"],
        transcript=transcript.strip()[:2000],
        metrics=metrics,
    )
    clip["warnings"] = clip_warnings(metrics, emotion=emotion)
    # A previous error state should not block a voice that now has audio again.
    if voice["status"] == "error":
        store.update_voice(voice_id, status="draft", error="")
    return clip


@app.get("/api/clips/{clip_id}/audio")
async def clip_audio(clip_id: str):
    clip = store.get_clip(clip_id)
    if not clip:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Sample not found.")
    path = _clip_path(clip)
    if not path.exists():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Audio file is missing on disk.")
    return FileResponse(str(path), media_type="audio/wav", filename=f"{clip['emotion']}.wav")


@app.delete("/api/clips/{clip_id}", status_code=204)
async def delete_clip(clip_id: str) -> None:
    if not store.delete_clip(clip_id):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Sample not found.")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------- training


@app.post("/api/voices/{voice_id}/train", status_code=202)
async def train_voice(voice_id: str) -> dict:
    voice = _voice_or_404(voice_id)
    if voice["status"] == "training":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="This voice is already training.")
    if not voice["consent"]:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400, detail="Consent is required before training a voice."
        )

    clips = store.list_clips(voice_id)
    neutral_seconds = sum(c["duration"] for c in clips if c["emotion"] == "neutral")
    if neutral_seconds < MIN_NEUTRAL_SECONDS:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=(
                f"Add at least {MIN_NEUTRAL_SECONDS:.0f} seconds of neutral speech before "
                f"training (you have {neutral_seconds:.1f}s)."
            ),
        )

    store.update_voice(voice_id, status="training", error="")
    job = store.create_job(voice_id, "train")
    asyncio.get_running_loop().create_task(run_training(job["id"], voice_id))
    return job


@app.get("/api/jobs/{job_id}")
async def get_job(job_id: str) -> dict:
    job = store.get_job(job_id)
    if not job:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Job not found.")
    job["voice"] = store.get_voice(job["voice_id"])
    return job


def _training_worker(job_id: str, voice_id: str) -> None:
    try:
        voice = store.get_voice(voice_id)
        if not voice:
            raise RuntimeError("Voice disappeared before training could start.")
        clips = store.list_clips(voice_id)

        by_emotion: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
        for clip in clips:
            by_emotion.setdefault(clip["emotion"], []).append(clip)

        neutral = by_emotion.get("neutral", [])
        neutral_seconds = sum(c["duration"] for c in neutral)
        if neutral_seconds < MIN_NEUTRAL_SECONDS:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Neutral samples total {neutral_seconds:.1f}s; at least "
                f"{MIN_NEUTRAL_SECONDS:.0f}s is required."
            )

        store.update_job(
            job_id,
            status="running",
            progress=4,
            message="Checking samples",
            log_line=f"Found {len(clips)} samples across {len(by_emotion)} emotions.",
        )

        usable: list[tuple[str, list[dict], float]] = []
        for emotion in EMOTIONS:
            group = by_emotion.get(emotion, [])
            if not group:
                continue
            if emotion != "neutral" and sum(c["duration"] for c in group) < MIN_EMOTION_SECONDS:
                seconds = sum(c["duration"] for c in group)
                store.update_job(
                    job_id,
                    log_line=(
                        f"Skipping {emotion}: only {seconds:.1f}s "
                        f"(needs {MIN_EMOTION_SECONDS:.0f}s)."
                    ),
                )
                continue
            picked, seconds = _pick_refs(group)
            usable.append((emotion, picked, seconds))
            store.update_job(
                job_id,
                log_line=f"{emotion}: {len(picked)} take(s), {seconds:.1f}s of reference.",
            )

        if not any(e == "neutral" for e, _, _ in usable):
            raise RuntimeError("No usable neutral reference audio.")

        store.update_job(
            job_id,
            progress=10,
            message="Loading the voice engine",
            log_line=(
                "Loading XTTS v2 — the first run downloads about 1.8 GB."
                if engine.key == "xtts"
                else f"Using the {engine.label} engine."
            ),
        )
        engine.load()

        meta: dict = {
            "trained_at": time.time(),
            "engine": engine.key,
            "engine_label": engine.label,
            "stale": False,
            "emotions": {},
            "skipped": {
                e: round(sum(c["duration"] for c in g), 2)
                for e, g in by_emotion.items()
                if e not in {u[0] for u in usable}
            },
        }

        total = len(usable)
        for index, (emotion, picked, seconds) in enumerate(usable):
            start = 10 + (index / total) * 80
            store.update_job(
                job_id,
                progress=start,
                message=f"Learning {emotion} timbre",
                log_line=f"Conditioning {emotion} from {seconds:.1f}s…",
            )
            latent_path = store.model_dir(voice_id) / f"{emotion}.pt"
            try:
                engine.train_emotion([_clip_path(c) for c in picked], latent_path)
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                if emotion == "neutral":
                    raise
                store.update_job(
                    job_id,
                    log_line=f"Could not condition {emotion}: {_safe_detail(exc)}",
                )
                continue
            meta["emotions"][emotion] = {
                "seconds": seconds,
                "clips": len(picked),
                "latent": f"{voice_id}/model/{emotion}.pt",
                "trained_at": time.time(),
                "mock": engine.key == "mock",
            }
            store.update_job(
                job_id,
                progress=10 + ((index + 1) / total) * 80,
                log_line=f"{emotion} ready.",
            )

        if "neutral" not in meta["emotions"]:
            raise RuntimeError("Neutral conditioning failed; no model was saved.")

        store.set_model_meta(voice_id, meta, status="ready", engine=engine.label)
        store.update_job(
            job_id,
            status="done",
            progress=100,
            message="Voice ready",
            log_line=(
                "Training complete. Ready emotions: "
                + ", ".join(meta["emotions"].keys())
                + "."
            ),
            finished=True,
        )
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        message = _safe_detail(exc)
        store.update_voice(voice_id, status="error", error=message)
        store.update_job(
            job_id,
            status="error",
            progress=100,
            message="Training failed",
            error=message,
            log_line=f"Error: {message}",
            finished=True,
        )


async def run_training(job_id: str, voice_id: str) -> None:
    await asyncio.to_thread(_training_worker, job_id, voice_id)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ synthesis


def _speak_sync(voice: dict, clips: list[dict], payload: SpeakIn, out_path: Path) -> dict:
    meta = voice.get("model") or {}
    trained: dict[str, dict] = meta.get("emotions", {})

    emotion = payload.emotion
    if emotion not in trained:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=(
                f"'{emotion}' is not trained for this voice. Train it with a few "
                f"emotional samples, or pick one of: {', '.join(trained) or 'none'}."
            ),
        )

    latents: dict[str, Path] = {}
    for name, info in trained.items():
        latent_path = store.root / info.get("latent", "")
        if info.get("latent") and latent_path.exists():
            latents[name] = latent_path

    refs_by_emotion: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
    for clip in clips:
        refs_by_emotion.setdefault(clip["emotion"], []).append(clip)
    refs, _ = _pick_refs(refs_by_emotion.get(emotion) or refs_by_emotion.get("neutral") or [])

    language = payload.language or voice["language"] or "en"
    try:
        result = engine.synthesize(
            text=payload.text,
            language=language,
            speed=payload.speed,
            out_path=out_path,
            emotion=emotion,
            intensity=payload.intensity,
            latents=latents,
            ref_paths=[_clip_path(c) for c in refs],
        )
    except EngineUnavailable as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail=_safe_detail(exc)) from exc
    except EngineError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=_safe_detail(exc)) from exc
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=500,
            detail=f"Synthesis failed: {_safe_detail(exc)}",
        ) from exc
    return result


@app.post("/api/voices/{voice_id}/speak", status_code=201)
async def speak(voice_id: str, payload: SpeakIn) -> dict:
    voice = _voice_or_404(voice_id)
    clips = store.list_clips(voice_id)
    if not clips:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Add samples before synthesising.")
    if voice["status"] != "ready" or not voice["model"].get("emotions"):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=409,
            detail="Train this voice before generating speech.",
        )

    generation_id = new_id("g")
    out_path = store.output_path(generation_id)
    try:
        result = await asyncio.to_thread(_speak_sync, voice, clips, payload, out_path)
    except HTTPException:
        out_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        raise
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        out_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=500, detail=f"Synthesis failed: {_safe_detail(exc)}"
        ) from exc

    duration = result.get("duration") or wav_duration(out_path)
    generation = store.add_generation(
        generation_id=generation_id,
        voice_id=voice_id,
        text=payload.text,
        emotion=payload.emotion,
        intensity=payload.intensity,
        speed=payload.speed,
        language=payload.language or voice["language"],
        engine=engine.label,
        path=out_path,
        duration=duration,
    )
    generation["voice_name"] = voice["name"]
    return generation


@app.get("/api/generations")
async def list_generations(limit: int = 100) -> list[dict]:
    limit = max(1, min(500, limit))
    voices = {v["id"]: v["name"] for v in store.list_voices()}
    rows = store.list_generations(limit)
    for row in rows:
        row["voice_name"] = voices.get(row["voice_id"], "Deleted voice")
    return rows


@app.get("/api/generations/{generation_id}/audio")
async def generation_audio(generation_id: str):
    generation = store.get_generation(generation_id)
    if not generation:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Generation not found.")
    path = store.root / generation["path"]
    if not path.exists():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Audio file is missing on disk.")
    stem = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+", "-", generation["text"][:40]).strip("-") or "speech"
    return FileResponse(
        str(path), media_type="audio/wav", filename=f"timbre-{stem}.wav"
    )


@app.delete("/api/generations/{generation_id}", status_code=204)
async def delete_generation(generation_id: str) -> None:
    if not store.delete_generation(generation_id):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Generation not found.")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------- static

if WEB_DIR.exists():
    app.mount("/", StaticFiles(directory=str(WEB_DIR), html=True), name="web")


@app.get("/api")
async def api_root() -> dict:
    return {"name": "Timbre", "version": app.version, "docs": "/docs"}
